requirements.description: User prefers properties near green spaces. Value set to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to the nearest integer.
Energy class D or better: the user requires the building to be in class D or higher (A1 through D).

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 600. The capacity of 45 people is not converted into an area threshold, since no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class (D or better) and proximity to green spaces are not among the reference columns and are not extracted here. The city of Turin is a geographic request handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not set.

output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (Attività scolastiche) with surface_area >= 600, energy_class from A1 to D, green score >= 74, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point. The capacity of 45 people has no matching column, so it is not filtered.
